# Daily Report — 2026-10-17

## Task Completed
Added knowledge base article version history tools (`list_kb_article_versions`, `get_kb_article_version`) targeting the `kb_knowledge_version` table.

- `list_kb_article_versions` — lists all versions of a given KB article (by article sys_id); filters by `workflow_state`; results ordered newest-first; full pagination with `has_more`/`next_offset`.
- `get_kb_article_version` — retrieves a single version record by its sys_id; 404 and empty-result guards.
- Both tools return: version number, workflow_state, author, size, timestamps, short_description snapshot, and article sys_id.
- Registered in `knowledge_author`, `service_desk`, and `full` packages.
